name: 满月形态
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square 1:1 opaque game card illustration for 满月形态 (Full-Moon Form). A FRESH creative composition, not the old standing-pose moon backdrop. No card frame, text, watermark, logo or UI.

REFERENCE ROLES: inputs1/2 are DRAWING STYLE only: broad opaque painterly anime portrait and economical dark-coat portrait. Make this output deliberately ROUGHER and less detailed, borrow brush grammar, not their people, outfits or props. Input3 is solely Xingyue's approved CHARACTER DESIGN, not its standing pose, lantern or white background.

CREATIVE IDEA: the instant a missing moon becomes FULL — Xingyue completes a circular moon gesture as she turns into her full-moon form. Camera slightly HIGH, three-quarter view, thigh-up composition. Her body is in a flowing rotating step, shoulder and waist at opposing angles; she turns her face upward toward the viewer, clear warm GOLD eyes, calm quietly confident expression. One hand lifted outward at shoulder height guides the top ivory crescent arc, the other hand lower across the waist guides a second larger ivory arc. Both hands are anatomically natural, separated and readable, not cupped prayer or symmetrical raised arms. Her deep teal cape spreads as one broad curved shape on one side, white skirt fans into the opposing curve on the lower side, and thick low braid sweeps around the circle. These shapes share a circular direction while preserving character anatomy.

MOON MOTIF: TWO very broad flat IVORY crescent brush-shapes, one above/behind her raised hand and one behind/below the waist, visibly completing ONE OPEN-BREATHING circular FULL-MOON silhouette around the rotating figure. It should read as a single circle being made whole, a few calm paint overlaps at the joining points, not many rings or a halo sitting on her head. The central circle area is a quiet pale warm-gray flat mass partly covered by the figure; the two crescent sweeps at its outer edge reveal her completing its contour. Leave clear gaps around face and hands. Moon is ONLY an abstract emblem/painted color form, no moon surface texture, realistic glowing sphere, clouds, stars, lunar crater detail, runes, spell diagrams or particles. No physical object held in her hands; fingertips guide the abstract motif. The rotating cape/skirt/braid and closing arc imply transformation and fullness.

ABSTRACT BACKGROUND: ONLY large alternating SOLID fields of deep muted teal-gray, pale warm gray and moon ivory. Slightly off-center light circle contrasted with a dark teal crescent-shaped cutout makes 'missing -> full' visually legible. No environmental scenery, sea, mountains, buildings, ground, sky or realistic night. Flat broad areas with sparse purposeful brushwork, generous quiet negative space. Avoid central flat standing person with a giant disk simply pasted behind her.

XINGYUE: adult anime female priest in NORMAL form; pale cream-gold extremely long hair with thick straight blunt bangs above brows, side braid feeding a LOW thick plait. Warm golden eyes. A WHITE C-shaped crescent moon hairpin clipped FLAT into the hair at the top just above the bangs, slightly off-center to the VIEWER'S RIGHT, tilted, resting against hair (not floating, not a halo); tips toward upper right. White modest priest dress, small high collar and gold neck ring, small gold four-point star brooch, subdued gold trim and layered skirt with teal underlayer. Deep teal-green short shoulder cape with gold edging. Dark half-finger wrist guards and natural skin-colored exposed fingers. No lantern, sword or staff. No purple eyes, silver-white hair, dark crescent or black-purple shadow outfit.

PAINTING: ROUGH HAND-PAINTED ANIME COLOR STUDY, openly unfinished and broad, NOT polished pretty fantasy splash art. VERY LARGE opaque blunt swipes build whole hair locks, cape and skirt planes. A base color plus ONE coherent shadow group and 2–3 broad midtone strokes per large region. Coherent curved locks and wide cloth strokes follow form. Slight irregular outlines, broken brush endings, small exposed edge gaps and a few sparse structural sketch marks, surrounded by quiet paint interiors. Hair a few substantial cream-gold masses with broad gray-gold shadow turns, no individual strands, little pale scratches or fine flyaway network. Clothes retain volume with large fold planes, not dense creases, embroidered trim or fragmented triangles. Face unmistakably anime, clear golden iris/pupil and confident upper-lid shapes, small economical nose/mouth, quiet warm skin and one cheek/neck shadow; no glossy beauty render or realistic skin. Hands readable but simple. Matte muted white/teal/gold with gold localized to eyes and identity trim. Moon/wind-like rotation marks flat opaque ivory, no bloom.
Roughness means fewer WIDER purposeful marks, not grain/noise/canvas filter, countless chips or fine scratches. No airbrush gradients, 3D gloss, polished jewelry, specular rim glow, photoreal materials, all-over detailing or clutter. Face/gesture most selectively drawn; large clothing/moon shapes and backdrop deliberately coarse. Head, moon clip and hands leave comfortable image margins.
userDirection: 重绘满月形态，增加一点创意；沿粗笔/抽象背景/意象，不测试
